corrections_of_failed_receipt.cache_poison_claim_false: batch1 bf16_status.earlier_fail_explained attributed battery1 BF16_FAIL (rel=1.0/nan) to 'suspect poisoned on-disk shader/pipeline cache state'. FALSE CAUSALITY: the failure is the deterministic drain bug - at 5c7876ac (the commit batch1 cites) shaders/matmul_coopmat_bf16.comp line 200 reads 'for (uint rr = 0u; rr < 2u; ++rr)', so the drain wrote only rows {r0, r0+2} = rows 0..3 of each 8-row block and left rows 4..7 stale. A full-matrix check fails on shader source alone; no cache state is required to explain it, so no cache-poison hypothesis survives. 2de96dcd fixes it (rr < MAT/2u plus barrier() after all reads). The final_disposition downgrade to 'hypothesis' is superseded: the bug is proven, cache is irrelevant.
corrections_of_failed_receipt.row0_only_false_pass_false: batch1 bf16_status.clean_run_verification ('out vs ref at (1,8,8),(8,64,64),(8,64,32),(64,64,64) all agree - the staged bf16 coopmat kernel computes correctly') is void: with the rr<2 drain, any check exercising the full output matrix at those shapes fails (half of every 8-row block is stale), so the pass can only have come from a row-0-only (or subset) comparison. All previous correctness claims for this kernel are disregarded; this receipt replaces them with an every-element proof.
corrections_of_failed_receipt.source_commit_mismatch: batch1 lists source_commits [82ececc6, 5c7876ac, 6d55a054] and 'wheel build at 5c7876ac (DEV_RELEASE=1, source commit stamped)'. scripts-local/m1_window.sh stamps via export MLX_OMARCHY_SOURCE_COMMIT=5c7876ac on an rsync tree built with --exclude .git, so the stamp is an operator override, not content provenance. The worktree at window time carried uncommitted repair work (committed later as 2de96dcd, 2026-09-08 19:26:13 UTC, after the batch1 receipt file mtime 14:06 -0500), so the tested content was neither 5c7876ac nor any recorded commit. This validation builds from a real git clone (git bundle 6049968..branch fetched into ~/src/mlx-omarchy on the M1, worktree checkout) with build-wheel.sh resolving the stamp from git rev-parse - no MLX_OMARCHY_SOURCE_COMMIT override used anywhere.
